historical_adjust_bottle_tests.model: official RoboTwin posttrained checkpoint, local test

failure_analysis.check_success: Correct-side gripper closed; gripper-actor contact within 0.03m XYZ around alarm contact point 0; latched success.
observations: Left gripper approaches and closes near the alarm.
Most sampled later frames show closed gripper near top left/back side; no sustained move onto top button area.
Repeated hovering/small position changes persist to the action limit.
failure_analysis.inference: Failure likely occurs at establishing the required button contact rather than failure to produce arm movement.
failure_analysis.limitations: One 320x240 head camera and eight sampled frames cannot verify 3D contact distance, force, or a brief between-frame contact. Alarm actor is static so lack of object movement is not a failure indicator.

failure_analysis.check_success: Bottle functional point 0 must have z>0.9m and x<-0.15m for this left-side bottle.
observations: Bottle initially lies on near side of table.
Around action40, left gripper approaches/contacts bottle body.
By action80, bottle lies at back of table and is not held in the gripper.
Later sampled frames show arm motion around original area while bottle remains lying at back through action396.
failure_analysis.inference: Failure primarily at stable grasp establishment: initial contact appears to displace bottle and policy does not recover by re-localizing and grasping it. Not merely a small final target threshold miss.
failure_analysis.limitations: One head camera and eight sampled frames cannot verify exact 3D positions or forces. Push/collision is inferred from displacement between action40 and80; no continuous sustained lift is evident in sampled frames.
